title: Writing a node that expands into a subgraph

questions.q: What must a V3 schema set before a node may return expand?
questions.why: EXECUTE_NORMALIZED raises an exception without it. We ran that.

questions.q: What does the result of an expanding node usually hold?
options: A wire to a new node's output
questions.answer: A wire to a new node's output
questions.why: The new nodes haven't run yet. The engine resolves the wire on the second visit.

questions.q: You misspell a class name in the graph you expand into. When do you find out?
questions.why: Validation only sees the queued graph. execute() looks up each new class when it adds it.

questions.q: Why not build ids from a random number?
options: The inner nodes would get new keys and miss the cache
questions.answer: The inner nodes would get new keys and miss the cache
questions.why: The docs require ids to be the same between runs. GraphBuilder's prefix gives that.

questions.q: Node 2 gets a list of 2 items and expands on each call. What prefixes does GraphBuilder give?
questions.why: The middle number is the call index, set before each call by pre_execute_cb.
